ThingDef.label: paper
ThingDef.description: A material made from wood used for book making.

ThingDef.label: parchment
ThingDef.description: A long lasting material made from hides or skin used for book making.

ThingDef.label: cloth paper
ThingDef.description: A material made from fabric used for book making, sometimes also referred to as fabric paper or rag paper. Weak and easily torn. Highly flammable.
